summary: The level's graves, where players dig with a shovel in the game's digging minigame, shared by all players. A grave dug by one is open for everyone, including those who join later, and scripts can dig or refill one. Players' games report where graves are, so Grave.all() lists those in the server's level once a player has been near them. Nothing is saved, and all graves are full again after a server start.

all.summary: All graves that players' games have found in the server's level, nearest to `near` first if given.

params.near: Optional: a position { x, y, z } to sort from.

all.exampleLua:
for _, grave in ipairs(kcds.world.Grave.all()) do
  print(grave.id, (grave.dug and "dug out" or "full"))
end

get.summary: The grave with this id, or null.
get.exampleLua:
local grave = kcds.world.Grave.get(graveId)
if grave then
  print(tostring(grave.position))
end

nearest.summary: The grave nearest a position, within `radius` metres if given, or null.

params.radius: Optional: the furthest distance in metres.

nearest.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerCommand", function(player, command)
  if command ~= "grave" then
    return
  end
  local grave = kcds.world.Grave.nearest(player.position, 30)
  local message = (grave and "A grave " .. string.format("%.0f", grave:distanceTo(player.position)) .. " m away" or "No grave nearby")
  kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, message)
end)

resetAll.summary: Refills all dug graves for all players, and returns how many.
resetAll.example:
const refilled = kcds.world.Grave.resetAll();
console.info(`${refilled} graves refilled`);
resetAll.exampleLua:
local refilled = kcds.world.Grave.resetAll()
print(tostring(refilled) .. " graves refilled")
resetAll.exampleCs:
var refilled = Grave.ResetAll();
Log.Info($"{refilled} graves refilled");

id.summary: The grave's id: its location in whole centimetres, as "x,y,z". It stays the same across server starts.

position.example:
const { x, y, z } = grave.position;
console.info(`grave at ${x.toFixed(1)}, ${y.toFixed(1)}, ${z.toFixed(1)}`);
position.exampleLua:
local x, y, z = grave.position.x, grave.position.y, grave.position.z
print("grave at " .. string.format("%.1f", x) .. ", " .. string.format("%.1f", y) .. ", " .. string.format("%.1f", z))

dug.summary: Whether the grave is dug out.
dug.exampleLua:
if grave.dug then
  print("this grave is open")
end

distanceTo.summary: The distance from a position, in metres.
distanceTo.exampleLua:
if grave:distanceTo(player.position) < 3 then
  kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "You stand at a grave.")
end

dig.summary: Digs the grave out for all players. Returns false if it is already dug. graveDug does not fire, because no player dug it.
dig.exampleLua:
local grave = kcds.world.Grave.nearest({ x = 3187.1, y = 495.9, z = 40.5 }, 5)
if grave then
  grave:dig()
end

reset.summary: Refills the grave for all players, so it can be dug again. Returns false if it is full.
reset.exampleLua:
-- A dug grave refills after ten minutes.
kcds.core.Events.on("graveDug", function(player, grave)
  setTimeout(function() return grave:reset() end, 10 * 60 * 1000)
end)
